name: casp16_server_attack_msa_model_diversity_v1
parent_benchmark_policy: select explicit server benchmark after P14 score; default candidate is casp16_server_protein_v2_aliasfix unless v4_refmap is chosen first
source_recipe: MULTICOM4-style diverse MSA generation, extensive sampling, and ensemble quality assessment
GuijunLab/QA4-style enhanced MSA generation and model quality assessment
CASP16 complex-assessment finding that extensive sampling helped but model ranking stayed a bottleneck

input_policy.scoreable_subset_policy: Use the same scoreable subset as P14 unless P14 proves the input stack is broken; skipped no-reference targets remain fixed-set zeros.
input_policy.variant_rule: Every variant must be generated by a target-agnostic rule before prediction. Do not choose variants per target from scores.

variant_classes.name: control_full_msa_template
variant_classes.description: Current Protenix full-MSA/template scoreable input stack.

variant_classes.name: alternative_msa_cutoff_or_database
variant_classes.description: Different MSA generation tool, database, coverage, or e-value policy applied globally, not per target.

variant_classes.name: domain_aware_msa_variant
variant_classes.description: Domain-aware MSA construction for long or multidomain protein targets using benchmark metadata and public sequence annotations only.

variant_classes.name: second_af3_like_backend_or_model_variant
variant_classes.description: OpenDDE/Protenix/AF3-like variant if it can run production MSA/template settings under the same benchmark and selection rules.

forbidden_toy_settings: manual per-target parameter changes after seeing scores

allowed_selection_signals: prediction confidence JSON generated by the same run
interface confidence when emitted by the predictor
geometry and clash diagnostics computed from predictions only
forbidden_selection_signals: leaderboard rows used as a per-target oracle
manual per-target intervention after seeing scores
launch_gate: Merge and score P14 first, or explicitly supersede P14 with a recorded reason.
Do not launch if P14 has many missing predictions, metric failures, or exact-artifact lookup failures; fix the pipeline first.
Do not launch if P14 is mainly reference-limited; use versioned refmap recovery or the v4/P15 row instead.
Prefer the prepared protenix25_scoreable_nofail row if P14 shows broad nonzero signal and candidate selection is the likely bottleneck.
Only create executable run specs after all variant inputs exist, all MSA policies are explicit, and a preflight report proves no stale cache paths.
Score only after all 20 declared candidates exist for every predicted target, or mark the row partial/unranked.

execution_policy.merge_policy: final merged run must declare candidate_count=20 and include every variant/seed candidate before ranked scoring
execution_policy.gpu_budget_policy: record expected GPU-hours before launch and actual wall time after each shard

budget_note: This design exists to reproduce the public CASP16 lesson that stronger systems used input/model diversity plus QA, not a toy no-MSA setting and not hidden target-specific tuning. It is intentionally not queued before P14, because P14 determines whether the next compute should be P15 refmap, P25 more seeds, D6a input repair, O5 antibody/Fv, or this MSA/model-diversity budget.
